text: LiteRT-LM's models/embeddinggemma2/EmbeddingMetadataProto_vision140.pbtext sets max_input_length: 1024, and its README describes it as metadata for EmbeddingGemma 2 models configured with 140 visual tokens (1260 max patches).

For an EmbeddingGemma file without a prefer_activation_type section item, LiteRT-LM's EmbeddingEngineSettings resolves the text encoder's activation type to FLOAT16 when the backend is GPU (unless set in code), and SetCommonGpuOptions maps any non-FLOAT32 activation type without mixed precision to GPU precision kFp16, so embeddinggemma-2-text-270m runs its encoder with FP16 activations on the GPU by default.

When max_input_length or min_input_length is set, LiteRT-LM's SelectSignaturesByCapacity keeps text encoder signatures in ascending length from the first not shorter than min_input_length up to and including the first at least max_input_length long, and fails with InvalidArgument if max_input_length exceeds the longest signature; CompileTextEncoder compiles only the selected signatures.

With insert_special_tokens (default true), LiteRT-LM's EmbeddingEngineImpl::InsertSpecialTokens puts the metadata BOS ids before the contents and the EOS ids after them, and raw text is tokenized with SentencePieceTokenizer::TextToTokenIds, a plain Encode that adds no special tokens; so an EmbeddingGemma 2 text input of t tokens runs as t + 2 tokens.

EmbeddingLiteRtCompiledModelExecutor::RunEncoderForTokens fills the embeddings input with the token lookup (LookupPrefill), writes input_mask 1.0 for the real tokens and 0.0 for the remaining positions, fills a per-layer input only when the signature has an input whose name contains per_layer and a per-layer lookup exists, and the executor creates a per-layer lookup only from a per-layer embedder section.

LiteRT-LM's EmbeddingLiteRtCompiledModelExecutor::ComputeEmbedding compares the token count with the longest loaded encoder signature M: kError returns InvalidArgument 'Input sequence length (N) exceeds maximum supported signature length (M).', kTruncate resizes to M and overwrites the end with the EOS ids when given, kChunkAndAverage embeds ceil(N/M) consecutive chunks and averages the raw outputs.

LiteRT-LM's EmbeddingEngineImpl::ComputeEmbeddingInternal resizes the embedding to options.output_size when set (InvalidArgument if negative or larger than the model's output) and then L2-normalizes it when options.normalize (default true), so a Matryoshka-truncated vector is returned with unit length.

LiteRT-LM's embedding batch calls (EmbeddingEngineImpl::ComputeEmbeddingBatch and EmbeddingLiteRtCompiledModelExecutor::ComputeEmbeddingBatch) process the requests one at a time in a loop; the executor's comment says batch inference isn't supported yet.

The v0.18.0 sources (b2f686e2) behind Agello's shipped LiteRT-LM have the same embedding defaults as agello-next: ResolveDefaults copies min/max_input_length from the file's metadata, the GPU activation type falls back to FLOAT16, and EmbeddingOptions defaults to normalize true, insert_special_tokens true and input_overflow_strategy kError.

The Swift EmbeddingEngineConfig (backend default .cpu(), cacheDir, maxInputLength, visionTokensPerImage) has no activation type, EmbeddingEngine.initialize calls litert_lm_embedding_engine_settings_set_max_input_length only when maxInputLength is non-nil and never calls litert_lm_embedding_engine_settings_set_activation_data_type, which the C API provides.

Agello 93122b647a downloads EmbeddingGemma from litert-community/embeddinggemma-2-text-270m-litert-lm, file embeddinggemma-2-text-270m.litertlm, expected size 164,626,432 bytes, at the ModelSpec default revision 'main' rather than a commit.

Agello 93122b647a's LiteRTEmbedder loads lazily, creating an EmbeddingEngine with EmbeddingEngineConfig(modelPath:backend:cacheDir:) on .gpu and, if initialize fails, on .cpu(); it embeds documents with computeEmbeddingBatch in groups of 8 and queries with computeEmbedding.

Agello 93122b647a's Chunker targets 1,600-character passages (commented as ~400 tokens of English at ~4 characters per token) with 200 characters of overlap; chat search text is the title plus the first 6 turns cut to 1,500 characters, embedded with title 'none'; web passages are embedded with title 'none'.

Agello 93122b647a counts a chat as related when its cosine score is at least 0.60 and at least 0.08 above the median chat's (needing 3 or more chats), thresholds calibrated on device at 256 dimensions; the embedder identifier is 'embeddinggemma-2-text-270m@256' and a different identifier triggers re-indexing; EngineCache keeps the embedder's cache folder ('embedding' or 'embedding-<build id>') when trimming.

Agello 93122b647a's prompt formats ('task: search result | query: ' for queries, 'title: {title or none} | text: ' for documents) are the google/embeddinggemma-2 card's SearchQuery/Document retrieval pair, and its 256-dimension truncation is one of the card's MRL dimensions with LiteRT-LM re-normalizing after truncation.

text: Storing Agello's unit-length 256-dimension vectors as float16 changes a cosine score by at most about 2^-11 (~0.0005) per stored vector, since round-to-nearest float16 has a relative error of at most 2^-11 for normal values and sum |q_i d_i| <= 1 for unit vectors (subnormals add at most about 2^-25 per component).
formula: |sum q_i (d_i - fl16(d_i))| <= sum |q_i| |d_i| 2^-11 <= 2^-11 = 0.000488 (Cauchy-Schwarz with unit vectors)

text: With kChunkAndAverage, LiteRT-LM splits the full token list (BOS and EOS already inserted) into hard M-token chunks, so only the first chunk starts with BOS and only the last ends with EOS, and averages the unnormalized chunk outputs before the engine's L2 normalization.

Agello 93122b647a's related-chat thresholds (0.60 and a 0.08 margin) are commented as calibrated on device in KnowledgeScenarioTests.test03 (matching chats 0.67-0.78, 0.09-0.15 above the median; unrelated up to 0.61, 0.02 above it), for the 256-dimension embedder.

EmbeddingLiteRtCompiledModelExecutor's GetTextEncoderSignatureMap keys every signature whose name starts with 'encoder' by the sequence length of its embeddings input (dimension 1 of a rank-3 tensor), and fails if none exists.
CompileTextEncoder creates input and output buffers for every selected encoder signature at compile time, and RunEncoderForTokens creates them lazily for a signature without cached buffers.
RunEncoderForTokens picks the signature with std::map::lower_bound on the token count (the smallest sequence length >= the tokens) and returns InternalError 'No suitable signature found' if none.
The Swift EmbeddingResponse carries only the embedding vector, while the C++ EmbeddingResponse also has input_length, truncated_length and num_chunks.
The C API's litert_lm_embedding_engine_settings_set_max_input_length and _set_min_input_length set the bounds that choose which text encoder signatures are loaded.

EmbeddingMetadata's min_input_length and max_input_length (runtime/proto/embedding_metadata.proto) are documented as defaults for auto-selecting text encoder signatures: signatures shorter than min are skipped and the smallest one holding max is the last loaded.

The EmbeddingGemmaV2 message in runtime/proto/embedding_model_type.proto carries image start/end tokens, patch width and height, max_num_patches, pooling_kernel_size, audio start/end tokens and skip_mel_spectrogram_extraction.
Agello 93122b647a's VectorIndex.top scores candidates by dot product (vDSP_dotpr) against the query and sorts them, relying on unit-length vectors for cosine similarity.

Agello 93122b647a's KnowledgeBase.currentEmbedder starts or queues the EmbeddingGemma download and returns nil when the model is not on the device, and uses the HashingEmbedder when configured for the mock engine.
Agello 93122b647a re-embeds a chat's search vector only while the chat has at most 7 turns (searchTurns + 1) and was updated after its last embedding.
